def build_update_snapshot(
    state: dict[str, object],
    model: PurePythonAdditionNN,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "epoch": state["epoch"],
        "step": state["step"],
        "sample": {
            "x1": state["x_1"],
            "x2": state["x_2"],
            "y": state["y_true"],
        },
        "learning_rate": state["learning_rate"],
        "forward": {
            "w1_times_x1": state["w1_before"] * state["x_1"],
            "w2_times_x2": state["w2_before"] * state["x_2"],
            "weighted_sum": (state["w1_before"] * state["x_1"])
            + (state["w2_before"] * state["x_2"]),
            "prediction": state["y_pred"],
            "error": state["error"],
            "loss": state["loss"],
        },
        "parameters": {
            "w1": {
                "before": state["w1_before"],
                "gradient": state["dL_dw1"],
                "update": model.w_1 - state["w1_before"],
                "after": model.w_1,
            },
            "w2": {
                "before": state["w2_before"],
                "gradient": state["dL_dw2"],
                "update": model.w_2 - state["w2_before"],
                "after": model.w_2,
            },
            "b": {
                "before": state["b_before"],
                "gradient": state["dL_db"],
                "update": model.b - state["b_before"],
                "after": model.b,
            },
        },
    }


def train_model(
    model: PurePythonAdditionNN,
    train_data: list[dict[str, int]],
) -> None:
    section("training_transparent_title")
    text(t("training_transparent_body"))

    epochs = 8
    learning_rate = 0.1
    train_losses = []
    step = 0

    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):  # @inspect epoch
        for sample in train_data:  # @inspect sample
            step += 1 # @inspect step
            x_1 = sample["x_1"]
            x_2 = sample["x_2"]
            y_true = sample["y"]

            w1_before = model.w_1
            w2_before = model.w_2
            b_before = model.b
            weights = {"w_1": w1_before, "w_2": w2_before, "b": b_before}  # @inspect weights

            y_pred = x_1 * w1_before + x_2 * w2_before + b_before  # @inspect y_pred

            error = y_pred - y_true  # @inspect error # @latex error=error=\hat{{y}}-y
            loss = 0.5 * (error**2)  # @inspect loss # @latex loss=loss=\frac{1}{2}(error)^2
            train_losses.append(loss)

            dL_dypred = error  # @inspect dL_dypred # @latex dL_dypred=\text{dL_dypred}=\frac{{\partial{L}}}{{\partial\hat{{y}}}}=\hat{{y}}-y
            dL_dw1 = dL_dypred * x_1  # @inspect dL_dw1  # @latex dL_dw1=\text{dL_dw1}=\frac{{\partial{L}}}{{\partial{w_1}}}=(\hat{{y}}-y)*{x_1}
            dL_dw2 = dL_dypred * x_2  # @inspect dL_dw2  # @latex dL_dw2=\text{dL_dw2}=\frac{{\partial{L}}}{{\partial{w_2}}}=(\hat{{y}}-y)*x_2
            dL_db = dL_dypred * 1  # @inspect dL_db  # @latex dL_db=\text{dL_db}=\frac{{\partial{L}}}{{\partial{b}}}=\hat{{y}}-y

            model.w_1 = w1_before - learning_rate * dL_dw1  # w_1 = w_1 - η * ∂L/∂w1
            model.w_2 = w2_before - learning_rate * dL_dw2  # w_2 = w_2 - η * ∂L/∂w2
            model.b = b_before - learning_rate * dL_db  # b = b - η * ∂L/∂b
            weights = {"w_1": model.w_1, "w_2": model.w_2, "b": model.b}  # @inspect weights

            update_snapshot = build_update_snapshot(locals(), model)  # @hide @stepover
            update_snapshot = update_snapshot  # @inspect update_snapshot @stepover @clear epoch sample step x_1 x_2 y_true w1_before w2_before b_before weights

            if epoch == 1 and step <= 5:  # @hide
                text(t(f"step_{step}_explanation"))

    final_parameters = {"w_1": model.w_1, "w_2": model.w_2, "b": model.b}

    final_parameters = final_parameters  # @inspect final_parameters

    translated_table(["table_parameter", "table_learned", "table_target"],[["w_1", f"{model.w_1:.2f}", "1.000000"], ["w_2", f"{model.w_2:.2f}", "1.000000"],["b", f"{model.b:.2f}", "0.000000"],],)
    text(t("training_complete_body"))

def run_inference(model: PurePythonAdditionNN) -> None:
    section("inference_from_scratch_title")
    text(t("inference_from_scratch_body"))

    test_cases = [
        (1, 2),
        (10, 20),
        (-2, 5),
    ]  # @inspect test_cases

    inference_rows = []

    for x_1, x_2 in test_cases: # @inspect x_1 x_2
        y_pred = model.forward(x_1, x_2) # @inspect y_pred
        y_real = x_1 + x_2 # @inspect y_real
        absolute_error = abs(y_pred - y_real) # @inspect absolute_error

### Ce que contrôle le taux d'apprentissage *lr*

*lr* (eta) est le taux d'apprentissage, un petit nombre positif choisi avant l'entraînement. Il fixe la taille de chaque pas : trop grand, les mises à jour peuvent dépasser le minimum et osciller ou diverger ; trop petit, l'entraînement avance dans la bonne direction mais met beaucoup plus de pas à y arriver. Tous les exemples de cette leçon utilisent *lr* = 0.1.

Pour utiliser ces trois formules, il nous manque encore un nombre pour chaque paramètre : $\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_1}$, $\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_2}$ et $\frac{\partial L}{\partial b}$, la dérivée partielle de la loss par rapport à ce paramètre. Rien ne nous donne ces valeurs directement ; le reste de cette section les construit à partir de zéro : un rappel de calcul différentiel, un forward pass concret, sa loss, puis la règle de chaîne appliquée en arrière jusqu'à ce que chaque gradient devienne un nombre réel.
